_about: The ranking short's layout, in px of the 1080x1920 frame. ONE source for prep/edl.py (places the screenshot, badge and caption boxes) and the Remotion look (sizes, colours). safe = margins Instagram Reels and TikTok cover with their buttons, username, description and top bar; everything we draw stays inside them. Numbers are the strictest of: TikTok 108 top / 320 bottom / 60 left / 120 right; Reels 220 top / 420 bottom (Ignite Social Media) and 210 / 310 / 84 right (Adaptly 2026); cross-platform 900x1400 centred (260 top). Plus a little extra at the bottom for two-line descriptions.
